description: NaBaSmSeO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent SmO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SeO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.92 Å. Ba is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent SmO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SeO₆ octahedra. All Ba-O bond lengths are 2.92 Å. Sm is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SmO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SeO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sm-O bond lengths are 2.29 Å. Se is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SmO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Se-O bond lengths are 1.84 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ba, one Sm, and one Se atom.
